newsitem.title: INDIA: Daimler-Benz India unit begins car export.
newsitem.headline: Daimler-Benz India unit begins car export.

text.p: Mercedes-Benz India Ltd (MBIL), the Indian joint venture of Daimler-Benz AG, said on Friday it had begun exporting cars assembled at its western Indian plant, with the first consignment going to Sri Lanka.

"October 24 will mark the first ambitious step of MBIL to export its E-class cars from its factory at Pimpri, Pune, to be shipped from Bombay to Colombo as the first export consignment of the company," it said in a statement.
"MBIL is going to secure new export orders for its E-class models in the coming months with practical solutions to regional requirements," it said.
MBIL is a joint venture between Daimler-Benz and Indian truck maker Tata Engineering and Locomotive Company.
